regions.merged_text: Congratulations on your practical Write in the "Priest." Too bad you could'nt have it in a hundred publications. Miss Beatrice McCahill was over from Chicago, 7612 N. Ashland. She promised a $100 for your Seminary some time ago if she got a certain favor. . Here with you'll find same. Delighted to give the surprise. I am trying to get it off To-Day. God help us! I hardly seem to be getting anything done - any- yet so much to be done. I am often at my wits' end what to do first. · God bless us all.

regions.merged_text: I hope this finds you well. I've not been too well now for a good week. But thank God I've been able to say holy Mass. We hope to see the Crisi in the Mercy Hall Hospital case, Detroit very soon. Her Enemies have hesitated at nothing to put over their lies.
